name: Shunjid Rahman Showrov
title: Senior Software Engineer (Team Lead)
summary: As Team Lead, I run the team's daily delivery, coach engineers through planning, career growth, and feedback, and work with Product and Design to remove delivery risks.

seo.description: Senior Software Engineer (Team Lead) at Optimizely with 5+ years building robust, scalable software: public APIs, webhook events, and developer tooling. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer (Team Lead)

Support engineers through coaching, task planning, career development, and feedback.
Collaborate with Product, Design, and other teams to align goals and remove delivery risks.
Drive technical excellence, continuous improvement, and a positive team culture.

description.text: Received monthly spot award with an appreciation message from a Software Engineering Manager saying,

description.quote: Shunjid is one of the most accomplished engineers on our team. His consistent track record of delivering tasks with exceptional quality in recent SPRINTs is truly commendable. He is always humble & open for suggestions, helped others to improve & produced high quality of works.

description.text: Received monthly spot award with an appreciation message from the team lead saying,

description.quote: Shunjid always tries to learn new things and apply the knowledge in his regular contributions to make our life easier. He has built trust and is always showing great responsibilities for his work.

description.text: I had the privilege of leading a team of 5 talented Software Engineering students in the highly competitive International Flutter Hackathon 2020. Together, we developed mobile application using a cutting-edge technology Flutter, which ultimately earned us the title of 'Runner-up'.

Microsoft Student Partners (Mumbai) organized an international programming tournament where the challenge was to code a bot using Python and Azure Cognitive Services API. Competing against talented participants from around the world, I made it to the final round and secured the 4th position.

Our team was selected as one of the top 20 teams among hundreds of applicants from all over the country for the final round of the competition. The challenge was to integrate a software's premium subscription billing with Grameenphone's Direct Operator Billing API. We were among the top teams who successfully accomplished this task and received certification.
Received an award in recognition of my outstanding academic performance during the summer of 2019, under the Department of Software Engineering at Daffodil International University.

Under the mentorship of Md. Anwar Hossen, Assistant Professor, Department of SWE, Daffodil International University, our team was awarded the prestigious title of champions in the Web Project category for our exceptional work on 'Routine Explorer and Analytical Intelligence' project.
Received a prestigious medal and certificate from the

in recognition of outstanding academic performance in the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination. This honor reflects excellence in academic achievement at the national level. The award ceremony was organized by Sheikh Russel Jatiyo Shishu Kishore Parishad.
